snippet.title: Fin-Tastic Battle - Oficial Trailer
snippet.description:
Fin-Tastic Battle is a fixed wave shooter where a lonely old man defends his home from an ancient civilization of orcas that claims the land as their promised territory.

What begins as a peaceful day quickly turns into an absurd war.

The game is a short 30-minute experience featuring 6 levels designed to be fun, intense, and challenging, with a strong humorous tone. It includes cinematics with voice actors that expand the story.

You can find it on itch.io and gato.us
